records.leaves: Alternate or opposite, ovate to suborbicular, heart-shaped at base; densely pubescent petioles to 20 cm
records.flowers: Long-pedicelled terminal racemes; calyx with five unequal united sepals; corolla to 55 mm, weakly bilabiate, tubular at base then wide-bell-shaped, dull white to lavender with purple/yellow inner mottling; four didynamous stamens
records.fruit: Capsule up to 10 cm long and 2–3 cm thick; matures into two curved hooked horns
records.taxon_note: Historical flora uses Pedaliaceae and explicitly notes segregation as Martyniaceae; modern repository Martyniaceae.
